title: Vectors in a Plane
seo_title: Vectors – SSS 3 Mathematics Worksheets with Answers (NERDC)
standard_text: Use column vectors; add, subtract and multiply vectors by scalars; find magnitude and direction; use position vectors and vector geometry. (summary of the NERDC SSS 3 Mathematics curriculum)
meta_desc: Free SSS 3 maths worksheets on vectors: column vectors, addition and subtraction, scalar multiples, magnitude, position vectors and vector geometry. 100 questions with answers.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • A vector has size and direction; a column vector shows the move across and up.
  • Add vectors by adding the tops and bottoms.
  • The magnitude is the length: |(3, 4)| = 5.

Examples

Example

a = (2, 5), b = (−1, 3)

(2 − 1, 5 + 3)

Answer: a + b = (1, 8)

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Writing a vector as a fractionA column vector has no line.
AB = OA − OBAB = OB − OA.
Forgetting the square root in the magnitude|v| = √(x² + y²).

items.q: Which vector is parallel to 4−1?
items.e: 12−3 = 3 × 4−1, a scalar multiple, so it is parallel: 12−3.

items.q: Which vector is parallel to 23?
items.e: 69 = 3 × 23, a scalar multiple, so it is parallel: 69.

items.q: 34 is parallel to 12k. Find k.
items.e: Parallel vectors are multiples of each other. The top component is 4 times as big (12 ÷ 3), so k = 4 × 4 = 16.

items.q: −25 is parallel to 4k. Find k.
items.e: Parallel vectors are multiples of each other. The top component is −2 times as big (4 ÷ −2), so k = −2 × 5 = −10.

The vector 3k has magnitude 5, and k > 0. Find k.
3−2 is parallel to k−6. Find k.
items.e: Parallel vectors are multiples of each other. The bottom component is 3 times as big (−6 ÷ −2), so k = 3 × 3 = 9.

items.q: 3−2 is parallel to k−8. Find k.
items.e: Parallel vectors are multiples of each other. The bottom component is 4 times as big (−8 ÷ −2), so k = 4 × 3 = 12.

items.q: OACB is a parallelogram. OA = a and OB = 4b. Find OC.
items.e: OC = OA + AC = a + 4b, so OC = a + 4b.

items.q: OACB is a parallelogram. OA = a and OB = b. Find AC.
items.e: AC is parallel and equal to OB, so AC = b.

items.q: OACB is a parallelogram. OA = a and OB = b. Find CO.
items.e: CO is the reverse of OC = a + b, so CO = −a − b.

items.q: OACB is a parallelogram. OA = a and OB = 2b. Find CO.

items.q: OA = 3a and OB = b. Find BA.
